_comment: Per-example WebGPU readback coverage baselines for VRT regression gating. nonDark is the rendered non-dark pixel ratio captured via copyTextureToBuffer (headless canvas presents transparent, so screenshots are unusable — see issue #4). The VRT gate asserts the live readback stays above nonDark * floorRatio, which catches rendering collapse (blank/black/missing geometry) while tolerating per-backend lighting/AA differences (Metal vs SwiftShader). Values were captured on macOS Metal; refine if a backend legitimately renders lower coverage. Keyed by the VRT snapshot name (without .png).
